notes: Raised by issue #676 Phase 5 (final phase — small, fully-untested core/ modules). Covers: peshitta_query.py (query_peshitta, needs the optional text-fabric package + the syrnt/tf Text-Fabric dataset, guarded with the same collection-safety try/except-import pattern as reportlab); targum_query.py (load_targum — the FileNotFoundError path is unconditional and always runs; the happy-path filtering tests skip since data/processed/targum.parquet isn't fetched in this environment — it requires a live Sefaria API fetch via scripts/fetch_targum_data.py, not run automatically); exercise_pdf/__main__.py — this module has NO `if __name__` guard and unconditionally runs ~180 real PDF builds into git-tracked lesson directories on mere import, so it is deliberately NEVER imported or executed by its test — instead tested via static `ast` parsing of its source to verify every one of the ~184 builder names it references is a real, callable attribute of bbh/bbg/bba, without ever triggering the module's own execution. This means __main__.py's own statements (the for-loops and try/except) remain uncovered by design — a deliberate safety tradeoff, not an oversight. unit_min_percent measured in an isolated venv matching CI's exact package list AND Python version (3.12, not the system default), with data/processed/ temporarily moved aside to match CI's fresh checkout (CI never builds it) — see the gotchas documented in docs/policies/test-coverage.md. Raised slightly (12.50% -> 12.56%) since targum_query.py's unconditional FileNotFoundError test lives outside pytest.mark.integration. full_min_percent measured in the regular fully-provisioned dev venv, raised 66.93% -> 67.05% (small gain — these are tiny modules and __main__.py contributes none by design). This completes issue #676 Phase 5, and with it every phase of the original plan. Update only via `scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same PR that earns the increase — see docs/policies/test-coverage.md.
